_README: EVERY1's public words, stated once. Both generators read this file: tools/gen_docs.py renders the messaging document at /documents/every1, and tools/build_ai.py renders the messaging section of brand.every1movement.com and the EVERY1 machine layer. Before this file existed the words lived only inside gen_docs.py, so the public site carried the marks and none of the language, and a partner organisation running a conference wrote its own. Everything here is approved and quotable by anyone carrying the mark. Anything that is not for a partner to repeat does not belong in this file.

lines: EVERY TRIBE, EVERY TONGUE, EVERY NATION
vision.sentence: Every tribe, every tongue, every nation will know the name Jesus.
vision.note: This is the text set into the vision lockup, and it is a brand fact rather than a caption. Quote it exactly. Where the lockup is used, do not re-set these words in live type beside it: the lockup already says them.

mission: To empower the local church to do the Great Commission and walk in God's calling.
promise: EVERY1 in the church going to EVERY1 outside of the church.
plain: The EVERY1 Movement sends the church out.
place: The EVERY1 Movement is the second movement of the journey. Its word is BURN. A cleaned heart catches fire, and fire starts fire.
whatItIs: A movement of ordinary believers who share Jesus where they already live, work, and study. You are the minister, sent by God everywhere you go.
It is a lifestyle, not an event. Membership is simple: you have shared Jesus with at least one person recently. That is the movement.
whoMayJoin: Every believer. There is no maturity requirement. When you are born again, you qualify.
The movement carries special fire for the young and the newly saved: their fire kindles faster and hotter.
firstSteps: Join the weekly prayer meeting, praying for the lost.
Share Jesus with one person this week.
Take the free personal evangelism course, offered through the School of the Local Church.
phrases: EVERY1 in the church for EVERY1 outside the church
standing: EVERY1 carries no endorsement line and no parent lockup. It is the one door that stands on its own, on the YouVersion model, across the movement, the app, and the activation platform alike. Do not add A ministry of THE WORD FOR ALL THE WORLD to EVERY1 material, and do not place the parent mark beside it.

voice.register: Plain, direct, and close to the field. Shorter sentences than the parent uses. Second person, because the reader is the one being sent.
rules: Say what happened. A report of one real conversation is stronger than any adjective about it.
Write to the person being sent, not about them. "You are the minister," never "believers are ministers."
Keep the ask to one action. A page with three asks gets none of them done.
Never make sharing Jesus sound like a technique or a funnel. It is a conversation with a person.
Never imply a maturity requirement, an age requirement, or a qualification. The movement's whole claim is that there is none.
Numbers come from the record or they are not used. No estimates presented as counts.

boilerplate: The EVERY1 Movement is a movement of ordinary believers who share Jesus where they already live, work, and study. It is a lifestyle, not an event: you are the minister, sent by God everywhere you go. Every believer qualifies, and the first step is simply to share Jesus with one person this week.

audiences.qualifier: Any age, newly saved or long saved
audiences.wants: to matter in the Great Commission without leaving their job, their school, or their city.
audiences.pain: the belief that evangelism belongs to pastors and missionaries, and that they are unqualified.
audiences.needsToHear: "You are the minister. You do not need a title or a stage. Share Jesus with one person this week."
audiences.firstStep: share Jesus with one person · join the weekly prayer meeting.

audiences.qualifier: Churches, ministries, and conferences carrying the mark
audiences.wants: to run an activation under EVERY1 without getting the brand or the message wrong.
audiences.pain: no clear standard to follow, and no way to check their work before it prints.
audiences.needsToHear: "Everything you need is published: the marks, the words, and a checker you can run yourself. Ask before it prints, not after."
audiences.firstStep: read brand.every1movement.com · run brand_check.py · write to brand@theword.world.
